channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Man remanded in custody after refusing to provide personal details to police
item.description: A 29-year-old man charged with multiple offences connected to a police raid on 4 January

item.title: Taxi driver charged with cocaine possession
item.description: The 29-year-old was seen handing drugs to people in Paceville, the court heard on Monday

item.title: Professor calls for ban on charity collection boxes and end to ‘dehumanising’ fundraising
item.description: University academic Andrew Azzopardi has urged a national rethink of charity funding in Malta, arguing that televised appeals, public begging and collection boxes undermine dignity and reflect a failure of social policy in an allegedly affluent country

item.title: Constitutional Court scraps €61,000 damages award to former police superintendent
item.description: Court rules that the first decision was not properly reasoned and the case must be reheard

item.title: Gozo Channel announces new timetable as MV Gaudos heads for maintenance
item.description: The company said that the vessel will be heading for maintenance, as the remaining two ferries will be operating under a new schedule for the time being

item.title: Six rapid response vehicles added to Mater Dei fleet
item.description: The Health Ministry explained that during the past year, the 112 Ambulance service responded to over 56,500 emergencies. This marks the highest number ever recorded and represents a 12% increase compared to 2024

item.title: Budget 2026 benefit increases start reaching families and pensioners
item.description: Revised social payments announced in Budget 2026 have begun taking effect, with around 140,000 families and individuals receiving higher pensions and benefits in the first payouts of the new year

item.title: PN decries government failure to provide HIV-preventing medicine
item.description: In a statement, the PN said government has failed to deliver on its pledge to introduce free PrEP medicine and has now allowed existing stocks of the medication to expire without arranging replacements

item.title: Venezuelas captured president pleads not guilty to drug charges in New York
item.description: Nicolas Maduro is accused in a New York courthouse of cooperating with drug trafficking cartels to help move thousands of tonnes of cocaine into the United States

item.title: Looking forward 2026 | Navigating the AI labyrinth
item.description: Research suggests the share of work hours spent using generative AI rose from 4.1% in late 2024 to 5.7% by August 2025, which is meaningful growth
